items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: so that's when Freddie Green joined the band... I'm pretty sure Brunswick. It was Billie Holiday recording date with Benny Goodman, Walter Page, Buck Clayton, Freddie Green , Mr. Teddy Wilson, and myself.

ctx.x: Say Jo, who was that sang that chorus on "Them There Eyes"? Sounded like Bill Coleman to me?

items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: January 25th, 1937. Buck Clayton, Benny Goodman, Lester Young, Teddy Wilson, Freddie Greene, Walter Page, myself, and Miss Billie Holiday.

ctx.x: That was the first Freddie Greene you got.

That's where you get Freddie Greene 'cause Freddie's out here, 'cause when he joined the band Walter Page said, no, it don't go like that. He had to change his whole - but Freddie was fortunate because Freddie started on banjo. Then he met Charlie and he was going to go and Charlie said, no, I'll sit up there with you. I used to sit up there with them, with two guitars, snare drum, and a sock cymbal, at the hotel - this is later. Then Big'Un said, no, it don't go like that.
